material.text: Draft email to the Head of Logistics at Meridian Enterprises

Subject: Quick question about Meridian Enterprises

Hi there,

Congratulations on your Series B! FleetSense is the leading fleet tracking and trip costing software platform, trusted by companies across India. We offer AI-powered workflows, 40+ integrations, role-based access, custom dashboards, mobile apps, audit trails and 24/7 support. Companies like yours have reduced trip costs reconciled by hand using our platform.

I'd love to show you a 45-minute demo next Tuesday at 4 pm. Also, if you sign before Friday I can get you 50% off the first year.

Looking forward to hearing from you!
